blockedReason: axe runs inside a browser page. This sandbox denies process creation (spawn EPERM), so no page could be loaded and axe-core never analyzed any DOM. Per the order, this is recorded as BLOCKED, never as passed.
note: criticalCount/seriousCount are null because axe did not run. Do not read them as zero.

staticEvidenceWithoutBrowser.method: Regex/inspection over the emitted dist/assets/*.js and *.css (not a DOM audit, not an axe result).

facts.hasRoleApplicationNote: role:`application` on the map <svg> (minified with template literals; verified at dist index chunk offset 701247 along with aria-label keyboard instructions and tabIndex:0).

keyboardEvidence.mapCanvas: role:`application` + tabIndex:0 + aria-label "…使用方向键平移，加号减号缩放，数字键 0 复位。"

reducedMotionEvidence.note: CSS contains @media (prefers-reduced-motion). Behavioural verification (animations actually suppressed) requires a browser and is NOT verified here.

contrastEvidence.reason: Contrast requires computed styles from a real renderer; no browser available. valuesForContrastRulesCannotBeComputedStatisticallyFromCSS.

whatCentralMustDo: Run `npm.cmd run test:e2e -- tests/a11y.spec.ts` with browsers installed. Any critical/serious axe finding will fail the suite.
